<!-- record draft for qa#3 to post (label: qa-run only). 18.4.0 round 2 part A, slice A-R1F: round 1's 11 FAIL items of #32940, re-judged at their current revisions (several re-pointed by #32965 / #33021). This file is the issue body; the probe log and per-clause tables are in record-A-R1F-clauses-1.md. -->

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main @ **`8e3d4a54`**, the same tree, build and console as record-A-P0. Tier 1 pins at this sha all green (3,403 tests, 0 failed; record-A-P0).
- Boots `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch` on ports 41271–41277, each stopped by process group. Installs, the interceptor config change, the deploy target and the namespace-collision packages all ran from scratch copies under `/tmp/qa3/A/ar1f/ws/examples`; the interceptor copy was compiled once inside itself, then booted `--no-compile`. `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json` ran with an isolated `HOME=` (`use-runtime` writes `~/.objectstack/cloud.json`). Browser legs in 2 fresh contexts.
- Timestamps (UTC): one runner, 09:50–10:18 (setup ≈10 min, test ≈18 min).

## Scope

Round 1's 11 FAIL items of #32940, at the resolver's current revisions: multi-currency-invoice 2 · home-amount-preview-states 1 · mcp-tool-call-interceptor 1 · dataset-member-vocabulary 1 · mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction 2 · deploy-runtime-dry-run-json 2 · namespace-co-owner-name-refusal 4 · namespace-object-name-refusal 2 · actions-namespace-address 3 · bare-name-one-holder-refusal 3 · permission-set-address-in-execution-context 3. None is in record-A-P0; permission-set-address-in-execution-context was briefly listed under A-FIX and is judged here.

## Derived item verdicts

| verdict | items (round 1 → now) |
|---|---|
| FAIL (3) | records-forms.multi-currency-invoice (A5, still #32941) · records-forms.home-amount-preview-states (A0, still #32941; A1–A3 blocked(product-bug) by it) · platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal (A0, A3 — stale spec again, re-point card `card-A-1.md`) |
| PASS (8) | ai.mcp-tool-call-interceptor (stdio leg 2/2 — see the probe on #32942) · studio-authoring.dataset-member-vocabulary (fixed by #33022, 83bd36de — #32943 can be verified closed) · ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction · cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json · platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal · platform-core.namespace-object-name-refusal · api-backend.actions-namespace-address · access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context (the last six as re-pointed by #32965 / #33021) |

## Fails — reproduction rule and disposition

**records-forms.multi-currency-invoice · A5 and records-forms.home-amount-preview-states · A0** — product defect, existing card **#32941** (open, no fix PR). Fresh stock boot, admin signed in through the form, INV-1004 → Edit: `[data-testid=home-amount-preview]` count 0 (expected 1, converted state); "Total incl. Tax" is plain text "€450.00"; switching to JPY and 01/15/2026 → "¥450", still no preview and no rate request. Reproduced in 2 fresh contexts. Mechanism unchanged since round 1: the expression-computed `amount` is readonly and `CurrencyField.tsx:64` returns before `HomeAmountPreview` at `:227`. The detail page's "Converted at 0.9 on Nov 13, 2026" hint is correct. A contributor-bound member gets no preview either (amount "—", their own rate read 403).

**platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · A0, A3** — stale spec, re-point card `card-A-1.md`. Two namespaces (qa_a, qa_b) both holding webhook `qa_hook`: both installs exit 0, the package-less `GET /api/v1/meta/webhook/qa_hook` answers 409 naming both, and a cold boot of a `packages[]` stack with both holders logs no webhook warning; rev 3 expects the second install refused 422 and one boot warning. #32577 (e55347d2, 05:13Z) put `webhook` into the namespace-scoped bare-name set an hour after #32965 (cf1b55c0, 04:04Z) re-pointed the clause to webhook. Control with `tool`: the install is refused 422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED naming the holder and the rename, and the cold boot logs exactly one "Bare-name conflict at boot" warning, for the tool. Round 1 (#32940 F-10) failed the same way on `flow`.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

Per-item minutes and doors are in the probe log (record-A-R1F-clauses-1.md). No new product defect.

- **#32942 (interceptor over stdio):** if the client sends its calls before "✓ Server is ready", the first call's `[qa-interceptor]` line reaches neither stream while later ones do; sent after ready, 2/2. This is likely round 1's case — worth adding to #32942's repro (the card stays open).
- Re-installing qa_b without its webhook answers exit 0 but the package-less webhook read keeps naming com.qa.addr-b until the next restart: the same shape as the browser record's `card-browser-2.md` (an upgrade doesn't withdraw dropped items until restart), not re-carded.

## Parked-on #32908

Fixture notes: `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json` should tell runners to isolate `HOME` (`use-runtime` writes the shared `~/.objectstack/cloud.json`); a package declaring a webhook needs `requires: ['webhooks','realtime']` or `objectstack build` refuses it; the only seeded USD draft (INV-1002) is re-currencied to EUR by multi-currency step 2, so preview-states should not run after it on the same DB.

Per-item checklist-accuracy notes follow.

**records-forms.multi-currency-invoice**
- Seed thin: only INV-1004 (EUR) and INV-1008 (JPY) carry a non-zero amount among the foreign invoices; the other three foreign rows prove only the rate choice (0 ÷ rate = 0).

**records-forms.home-amount-preview-states**
- (from the earlier browser-slice run, still applicable) A2's expected string spells the date ISO ("2024-06-01"); where the preview does mount (a scratch editable record-mode amount) the product renders "Jun 1, 2024". Not re-driven here.
- S0 names "a USD draft invoice"; the only USD draft seeded is INV-1002, which the sibling item's step 2 re-currencies to EUR. Run this item before multi-currency's step 2 on a shared boot, or use QA-created drafts.

**ai.mcp-tool-call-interceptor**
- The inline plugin's object literal needs a cast (`as any`) in a typed config; otherwise it boots as written.
- A registered call's log line carries no `registered` key (JSON.stringify drops `undefined`); only the unregistered call shows `registered:false`. The clause reads it only on the unregistered one, so this is fine.
- A4 should say "call after the server is ready", given the boot-window drop above.

**studio-authoring.dataset-member-vocabulary**
- A5's source pointer (packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.form.ts#datasetForm) is not what Studio renders: the designer is `DatasetDefaultInspector` + `DatasetMemberVocabulary.tsx` (#33022), which take the spec form's copy. The testids are `dataset-measures-synonyms` / `dataset-measures-description` (plural), useful to name in the item. The fields sit behind the row's "Advanced" toggle, which the step does not say.

**ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction**
- The page the budget stops at varies run to run on one host (7 and 20 at 60 ms), so the note's "after page N" is not a fixed oracle; the clause correctly asserts only the opening of the sentence.

**cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json**
- `os environments use-runtime` writes the target into ~/.objectstack/cloud.json (the user's home, shared by every runner on the host). Runners should set HOME to their work dir; the fixture text does not say so.

**platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal**
- A3's step says "repeat the install … in base"; with the same ids the base build is an upgrade of the qa_n com.qa.n-one (installed exit 0, namespace moved to base). Fresh ids would make the leg cleaner.

**platform-core.namespace-object-name-refusal**
- POST /api/v1/packages refuses `label` ("Unrecognized key(s) on this package manifest: `label`") and needs `type`; the fixture could spell the body: {id, name, type: 'app', version, namespace}.
- The draft save is `?mode=draft` on the same PUT; the step says "save it as a draft" without naming the switch.

**platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal**
- A webhook in a package needs `requires: ['webhooks', 'realtime']` or `objectstack build` refuses the stack ("webhook 'qa_hook' is declared but `requires` does not include…"); the fixture text omits it.
- The cold-boot leg is reachable with a defineStack `packages[]` of two bodies (no install door): this scratch app is a usable fixture for the item.
